name: Image edit, one reference, 1024x1024, 40 steps
description: Three edit prompts at 1024x1024 with a single conditioning image, one at a time. The cost of an edit over a plain generation of the same size.
notes: Concurrency is 1 on purpose: one image at a time is the shape of a single-GPU box for this class of model, and a second request in flight measures the queue rather than the device. Each prompt is rendered `repeat` times and the median is reported, with `warmup_requests` rendered first and excluded. `guidance: null` means the lane's own default — guidance above 1 runs a second transformer forward per step, so a lane that silently defaults to 4 is doing twice the work of one that defaults to 1, and the value that was actually used belongs in the result's args. A reference image is read twice — as vision context by the text encoder and as latent tokens by the transformer — so it costs sequence length in both, which is what separates this from t2i-single-1k-40s-v1.
